"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will encourage other federal agencies to negotiate self-governance agreements with Tribes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Consistent with the policies of the Obama-Biden Administration, Democrats will make permanent the White House Council on Native American Affairs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats commit to holding an annual White House Tribal Nations Conference.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will nominate federal judges who understand Indian law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure Native Americans and Alaska Natives are appointed to high-level and leadership positions within the federal government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Over 70 percent of Native Americans live off-reservation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will create a strategy to support urban Indian populations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure the voices of urban Indian populations are heard.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will expand support to access quality health care for urban Indian populations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will expand support to access culturally relevant education for urban Indian populations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will expand support to access affordable housing for urban Indian populations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will expand support to access other programs for urban Indian populations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support efforts for self-governance and self-determination of Native Hawaiians.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Native Hawaiians are the Indigenous, aboriginal people of Hawai'i whose values and culture are the foundation of the Hawaiian Islands.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support proactive actions by the federal government to enhance Native Hawaiian culture.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support proactive actions by the federal government to enhance Native Hawaiian housing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support proactive actions by the federal government to enhance Native Hawaiian health.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support proactive actions by the federal government to enhance Native Hawaiian language.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support proactive actions by the federal government to enhance Native Hawaiian education.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats recognize and honor the contributions and sacrifices made in service to the country by Native Hawaiians.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
